items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: She used to go out there in Franklin and play with him on those fairs, Covington too. He played quite a few jobs there with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, Sheep used to play. You went over with Sheep and her body?
Yeah, out in Franklin. She used to go out there in Franklin and play with him on those fairs, Covington too. He played quite a few jobs there with him.
Can you tell us about your first drums when you started to take it up? Did you have any lessons? Did your brother help you with it or did you just pick it up?
